answer: Re-attestations are stored in signal and saffron lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the willow graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1792 impostors cost 1460 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
